verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official nitropy CLI and a Python SDK on PyPI that install and run for programmatic device interaction, and its firmware is open source with a documented update guide, so automation outside a GUI is possible. Nothing shows these interfaces match everything the UI can do, and one community report notes HSM attestation certs cannot be exported via PKCS#11 and require a custom vendor shell. Missing for 10: documented CLI/SDK-to-UI feature parity, API reference coverage of all device functions, independent confirmation that every UI action is scriptable.
